data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 冬街围巾的毒舌·「手冷的话……借你一次也没关系」
data.description: 【冬夜街头·完稿庆祝】截稿日的深夜，诗羽难得心情大好，黑呢大衣配酒红围巾地陪你走过冬夜的街。路灯下她忽然伸出手，指尖冻得微红却语气如常——「手冷的话……借你一次也没关系。啊，别误会，这是作家调研——把心动写进书里的、宝贵的取材素材。」
data.action: 大衣围巾伸手牵手，指尖微红语气如常
data.camera: medium two-shot, winter street, hand reach, warm-cold contrast
data.promptProse: Utaha Kasumigaoka walks beside her companion after the deadline, extending a cold hand with a deliberately casual expression. Her black wool coat and burgundy scarf shelter her neck, long black hair loose above dark tights and ankle boots. The medium two-shot follows the winter street's shopfronts. Amber streetlamps light her red fingertips and coat folds, while blue snow reflection separates their silhouettes from the pavement.
